question: How do professional primary sources distinguish roadmaps, releases, phases and milestones, and where does the current AI Cortex model differ?

scope.period: Inspected vendor guidance plus explicitly dated historical scheduling definition

subquestions.question: What does milestone mean, independent of its rendering?
How do roadmaps and release plans select granularity and relate phases to milestones?
Which local contract limitations matter for a follow-up design?

sources.title: Practice Standard for Scheduling, Second Edition
limitations: Copyright 2011; latest edition and continuing applicability were not established.

sources.title: Agile roadmaps: Build, share, use, and evolve
limitations: Vendor guidance, not a mandatory industry standard; publication date unavailable.

sources.title: What are roadmap milestones?
limitations: Vendor guidance; no adoption or effectiveness study inspected.

sources.title: Product Roadmaps: How To Create One Step-by-Step
limitations: Same provenance family as S3; not independent corroboration.

sources.title: Milestone (task field)
limitations: Documents a software field; does not redefine the abstract scheduling concept.

sources.title: AI Cortex Roadmap Modeling Schema 1.0.0
limitations: Observed pre-migration working-tree version 1.0.0: refs were entry/version IDs and each ref occurred once. Later versions may differ.

findings.statement: PMI defines a milestone as a significant point or event in a project.
findings.confidence_rationale: Directly inspected source content; assertion limited to the named document and version.

findings.statement: PMI models schedule milestones with zero duration and distinguishes them from activities with duration.
findings.confidence_rationale: Directly inspected source content; assertion limited to the named document and version.

evidence.locator: 3.2.1.1 Define Milestones, printed p.27 (PDF p.39); Glossary Schedule Milestone (PDF p.143)

findings.statement: Aha documents milestone categories covering achievements, approvals, deadlines, events and key meetings, with different detail for different audiences.
findings.confidence_rationale: Directly inspected source content; assertion limited to the named document and version.

evidence.locator: Types of roadmap milestones; How to identify roadmap milestones

findings.statement: Atlassian presents roadmaps as evolving product plans, recommends broader time horizons, and offers Now/Next/Later initiative mapping.
findings.scope: Atlassian Agile Coach guidance as inspected
findings.confidence_rationale: Directly inspected source content; assertion limited to the named document and version.

evidence.locator: What is an agile product roadmap?; Building the roadmap

findings.statement: Aha distinguishes strategy, feature and release roadmaps; release plans group features, and release roadmaps may show phases and milestones.
findings.confidence_rationale: Directly inspected source content; assertion limited to the named document and version.

evidence.locator: Types of product roadmaps; Product release roadmap template; Components of a product roadmap

findings.statement: Microsoft Project automatically marks zero-duration tasks as milestones but allows a one-day review meeting to be manually marked as a milestone.
findings.scope: Microsoft Project versions named on the inspected support page
findings.confidence_rationale: Directly inspected source content; assertion limited to the named document and version.

findings.statement: The current local generator contract restricts milestone refs to entry/version IDs and permits each ref only once, so it does not represent a distinct event alongside the same record span.
findings.confidence_rationale: Directly inspected source content; assertion limited to the named document and version.

evidence.locator: 5.3 Optional local generator interface, schedule item ref/kind and unique-ref paragraphs

findings.statement: The inspected sources do not justify one mandatory roadmap hierarchy or requirement-only presentation for every project; audience and planning depth matter.
findings.scope: Interpretation for possible AI Cortex design work
findings.confidence_rationale: Synthesis of inspected definitions and local contract; this is an interpretation, not a mandatory industry policy or adoption decision.

findings.statement: Separating milestone meaning, timeline rendering, release grouping and archival container semantics would address the local ambiguity without equating all four concepts.
findings.scope: Interpretation for possible AI Cortex design work
findings.confidence_rationale: Synthesis of inspected definitions and local contract; this is an interpretation, not a mandatory industry policy or adoption decision.

findings.statement: The appropriate milestone object fields and legacy archive migration policy for AI Cortex remain undecided.
findings.confidence_rationale: External documentation cannot decide the project-specific compatibility trade-off.
gaps: Project-specific design and legacy-consumer inspection are required.

conflicts.dimension: Abstract schedule model versus tool-field compatibility
conflicts.impact: The zero-duration convention must not be described as a restriction enforced by all professional software; the scopes explain the apparent discrepancy.

gaps.question: What does the latest PMI edition require?
gaps.reason: Only the official 2011 second-edition PDF was inspected.
gaps.validation_step: Verify a current authorized edition if formal current-standard conformance becomes a requirement.

gaps.question: Which milestone schema and legacy archive compatibility should AI Cortex adopt?
gaps.reason: Requires project design and consumer analysis, not a vendor-derived automatic policy.
gaps.validation_step: Inspect milestone-directory consumers and design explicit event identity, relationships and evidence before implementation.

summary: Primary sources distinguish significant events from duration-bearing work and allow several roadmap views. Aha guidance includes non-completion events; Microsoft exposes a duration-bearing milestone flag. Local milestone identity and archive semantics need a separate design decision. No normative repository assets were changed by this research.
